job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
RWR Construction has partnered with a specialist infrastructure contractor who is looking for a Project Manager to help deliver a range of stormwater, wastewater and drainage projects across Auckland and the North Island.

Projects include both new builds & maintenance projects.

You’ll manage multiple small to medium projects at various stages from planning through to completion, coordinating crews, subcontractors and suppliers while working directly with clients.

This role suits someone who enjoys running multiple projects end-to-end, rather than being responsible for a small piece of a large project.

This is a key position for our client, you will be part of the senior leadership team & reporting into the directors.

Key responsibilities:
  • Manage multiple infrastructure projects simultaneously
  • Coordinate site crews, subcontractors and suppliers
  • Interface directly with clients and consultants
  • Manage variations, commercial outcomes and contracts
  • Plan works, resources and materials
  • Troubleshoot technical issues onsite
  • Support design-build solutions where required
Projects include:
  • Stormwater and wastewater infrastructure
  • Pump stations and drainage systems
  • Septic and wastewater installations
  • Civil works associated with water infrastructure
About You:
  • 5+ years experience in civil or infrastructure construction
  • Experience with drainage, stormwater or wastewater projects
  • Engineering qualification, Civil or Mechanical preferred
  • Strong communication and practical problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and site teams
If you tick the above boxes & would like to find out more, click apply now or reach out to Alex on 027 370 7011 or alexb@rwrconstruction.co.nz

job.title: Operations Manager
job.description:
The Opportunity:

A growing specialist contractor operating across construction, civil infrastructure and asset maintenance is looking for an experienced Operations Manager to take ownership of its operational delivery function.
Reporting to the General Manager and sitting on the Senior Leadership Team, this role will work closely with the Commercial Manager and take responsibility for projects from contract award through planning, mobilisation, delivery, claims and closeout.

This is an Operations Manager role, not a Project Manager stepping up. The focus is on leading managers, driving operational performance and ensuring the people, resources and systems across the business are working together effectively.

The business has a strong pipeline of work and national growth ambitions. This person will play a key role in building the operational capability required to support that growth.

** Please note, this position is based in the Waikato and relocation is required **

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own operational delivery across multiple construction and infrastructure workstreams.
  • Lead approximately five direct reports across project delivery, HSEQ, scheduling/administration and plant and equipment maintenance.
  • Take ownership of operational P&L performance, including productivity, cost control, forecasting and resource utilisation.
  • Manage the handover from commercial/pre-construction through planning, mobilisation, delivery and closeout.
  • Oversee programming, labour, plant and resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Improve planning, communication, accountability and follow-through across the delivery teams.
  • Set clear expectations for operational managers and hold them accountable for performance.
  • Develop the capability of the managers and supervisors underneath the role.
  • Maintain oversight of project commercials, including claims, variations and contractual obligations.
  • Ensure project teams capture accurate and timely information to support claims and invoicing.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Manager on contractual and commercial issues throughout delivery.
  • Provide leadership oversight across HSEQ, QA, operational compliance and plant.
  • Identify operational risks, capability gaps and performance issues and address them early.
  • Build stronger systems and processes to support a growing national operation.
  • Contribute to business planning and strategic decision-making as part of the Senior Leadership Team.
Key Performance Indicators:
  • Project delivery against programme, budget, quality and client expectations.
  • Operational margin and overall P&L performance.
  • Labour utilisation, productivity and effective resource allocation.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of claims, variations and invoicing information.
  • Forward planning of labour, plant and project requirements.
  • HSEQ and quality performance.
  • Accountability and performance across the operational management team.Own operations, lead the team and drive performance for a growing specialist contractor with a strong national pipeline.
  • Development and capability of managers and supervisors.
  • Client delivery, repeat business and operational service levels.
  • Development of scalable systems and operational capability as the business grows.
What We're Looking For:

We are looking for an established Operations Manager with experience in construction, civil infrastructure, specialist contracting or a similar project led environment.

You will have proven experience leading managers and operational teams, with genuine responsibility for P&L and business performance.

Strong construction and commercial knowledge is essential, including an understanding of NZS 3910, claims, variations, programming and project financials.

You don't need to be the technical specialist; the priority is your ability to lead people, understand performance and get the best out of the resources around you.

Experience across both construction projects and asset maintenance or facilities environments would be advantageous.

You'll need to be comfortable entering a business where there is an opportunity to strengthen operational performance. Initially, that will mean getting into the detail, setting expectations and creating accountability before progressively empowering the team underneath you.

The role is predominantly office based in Hamilton, with site involvement and national travel when senior operational support is required.

For the right person, there is significant scope to grow with the business and potentially progress into broader business leadership over time.

If you tick the above boxes & would like to find out more, apply today or reach out to Alex on 027 370 7011 or alexb@rwrconstruction.co.nz

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Join an established New Zealand civil construction business with more than 30+ years of industry experience and a strong pipeline of infrastructure work.

Specialising in piling, precast concrete, retaining walls and bridge construction, the business delivers technically challenging projects throughout New Zealand. This is an opportunity to join a stable contractor, take ownership of multiple projects and work with an experienced civil team.

**Please note, this role is based in the Hawkes Bay & relocation is required**

Why Join?
  • Secure, long-term employment
  • Strong pipeline of civil and infrastructure projects
  • Projects valued up to $5 million
  • Career development and upskilling opportunities
  • Supportive, practical team culture
  • Company vehicle, phone and laptop
The Role Reporting to the Civil Manager, you will manage civil construction projects from planning through to completion, ensuring they are delivered safely, on time, within scope and within budget.

This position involves operational delivery, commercial management, client communication and team leadership. You may oversee several projects concurrently, so strong organisation, commercial awareness and the ability to prioritise are essential.

The position is permanently based in Hastings. Candidates currently living elsewhere must be willing to relocate to Hawke’s Bay. This is not a FIFO opportunity.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Manage civil projects valued up to $5 million
  • Lead, support and mentor civil delivery teams
  • Develop and manage project programmes, budgets and resources
  • Coordinate with clients, site teams and production teams
  • Monitor project costs, financial performance and variations
  • Oversee contractual, quality assurance and reporting requirements
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and progress updates
  • Ensure health and safety standards are consistently maintained
  • Assist with tenders, pricing, quotes and client submissions
  • Participate in management, project and toolbox meetings
  • Maintain strong client relationships throughout delivery
Skills and Experience You will ideally bring:
  • At least five years’ Project Management experience in New Zealand civil construction
  • Experience delivering piling, deep foundations, structures, bridges or retaining-wall projects
  • Strong knowledge of NZS 3910 and NZS 3916 contracts
  • Experience with cost control, financial reporting and pricing variations
  • Sound knowledge of civil construction methods, procedures and equipment
  • Strong planning, operational and organisational skills
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • A practical and confident leadership style
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability
  • The ability to mentor others and contribute to a high-performing team
  • A strong understanding of health and safety requirements
  • A valid New Zealand driver licence
  • The legal right to work in New Zealand
Position Details:
  • Based in Hastings, Hawke’s Bay
  • Permanent relocation to Hawke’s Bay is required
  • Full-time, permanent position
  • Occasional travel based on project requirements
  • Company vehicle, phone and laptop provided
If you are an experienced Civil Project Manager looking for long term stability, technical project variety and the opportunity to make a genuine impact within a well established contractor, apply now or reach out to Alex on 027 370 7011 or alexb@rwrconstruction.co.nz

job.title: Pre-Construction Project Manager
job.description:
We’re working with an established New Zealand interiors and construction business looking for a Project Manager to join their Auckland team, with a focus on preconstruction and getting projects ready to build.

This is a front-end project role. You’ll take ownership once a project is moving, bringing together the client, design team, QS, consultants and construction team to turn the initial concept into something that is properly designed, priced, consented and ready for construction.

You don’t need to have been a Preconstruction Manager before. Our client is open to people from project management, architecture and technical design who have the right foundations to step into the role.
The Role You’ll own the preconstruction phase across a number of projects, typically in the $1m–$5m range.

A big part of the role is keeping everything moving. You’ll drive the programme, make sure decisions are being made and keep the design developing in line with the client’s budget and expectations.

Working closely with the QS and wider project team, you’ll be involved in progressive budgeting, consultant coordination, consenting, procurement and tendering. You’ll lead client and project meetings, identify risks early and work through issues before they become problems during construction.
Ultimately, you’re responsible for getting the project to an agreed construction contract and making sure there’s a clean transition into the Construction PM who will deliver it on site.

About You.
 
The client side of this role is important.

You’ll need to be polished and credible in front of clients, comfortable talking through budgets and project decisions and confident enough to have difficult conversations when something isn’t stacking up.

You’ll also need to be commercially aware, but you don’t need to be a QS. There’s good cost-management support around the role. What matters more is understanding the implications of decisions and being able to keep the client, design and budget heading in the same direction.

Your background could be in project management consultancy, architecture, architectural technology, technical design or another relevant interiors or construction environment. If you’re coming from architecture or design, a technical or documentation-focused background is likely to translate particularly well.

We’re also interested in someone who is curious and adaptable. Our client has an established methodology for taking projects through preconstruction, so they’re looking for good foundations and a willingness to learn rather than someone with a fixed view of how projects should be run.

Construction contract knowledge would be useful but isn’t essential.
This is a predominantly office-based role in Auckland CBD, working closely with the design, QS, project and construction teams.

If you enjoy the front end of construction projects, like bringing the different pieces together and want more ownership across the client, design and commercial process, this could be a good next step.

Apply through SEEK or contact Maximilian at RWR Construction for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Sales Manager
job.description:
There are sales management roles where you inherit a team that needs fixing. This isn't one of them.

This is an established Nelson construction business with a five-person sales team that already includes some of the strongest performers in the wider group. Two have been doing it for around 15 years and consistently sit amongst the top performers nationally, while others are earlier in their sales careers and bring plenty of energy and opportunity.

That's what makes the leadership piece interesting. They need someone who can earn the respect of experienced high performers without getting in their way, while giving newer people the coaching, structure and confidence to develop their own approach.

Importantly, this isn't a selling role. You won't carry your own target or compete with the team for leads. Your focus is entirely on the performance of the people around you and creating an environment where they can do their best work.

There's also a genuine opportunity to improve how the sales function operates. You'll take ownership of pipeline visibility, follow-up, reporting and forecasting, while looking at where systems and processes could be simpler, smarter and more consistent.

Digital confidence will be important. They're not looking for an IT expert, but they do want someone who understands the value of good data, gets what a CRM should be doing for a sales team, and can spot opportunities to make things work better.

Ultimately, they're looking for someone who knows that good sales leadership isn't one-size-fits-all. You'll need enough confidence to challenge when required, enough judgement to know when to coach, and enough restraint to give good people room to perform.


What are we looking for?
You don't necessarily need to come from residential construction. We're interested in people who have genuinely led sales teams and can show how they've helped people perform, introduced better ways of working and created accountability without turning everything into a corporate exercise.

Experience in property, building products, automotive, professional services or another considered sales environment could translate well. What's more important is that you understand sales, can work with different personalities and levels of experience, and have enough energy to keep things moving.

You'll also need to be comfortable bringing ideas to the table. This is a growing business and they're looking for someone who can look at what's working, keep it, and identify where things could be done better.

Why consider it?
There's a lot to work with here. You're joining a growing local business with an established team, proven performers and owners who want to continue improving how the business operates.

You aren't being brought in to rebuild a broken sales function. The opportunity is to bring leadership, coaching, systems and structure around a team that already has plenty of runs on the board, then help lift the whole group from there.

If you're the sort of sales leader who gets more satisfaction from seeing the whole team win than being the person at the top of the leaderboard, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Ginny at RWR Construction for a confidential cat.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
We're recruiting for an established business operating within the construction sector.

This is an opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of the commercial function while remaining closely involved in the day-to-day management and delivery of projects.

You'll oversee the commercial pipeline, maintain key relationships with head contractors and their project teams, ensure strong commercial disciplines are followed, and personally manage projects from tender through to delivery and completion.

It's a broad role that will suit someone who enjoys having visibility across the commercial picture but doesn't want to step away from the detail of making projects happen.
 
Daily, you will be across the commercial function, you'll take responsibility for both securing and successfully delivering work.

You'll be responsible for:
  • Taking ownership of the commercial project pipeline
  • Reviewing plans, specifications and tender documentation
  • Identifying key project requirements, risks and potential issues
  • Coordinating accurate and well-scoped tender submissions
  • Following up tenders and helping convert opportunities into secured projects
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with head contractors, Project Managers and QSs
  • Managing your own portfolio of commercial projects from award through to completion
  • Coordinating project documentation, technical information and site requirements
  • Connecting internal teams, customers and contractors throughout delivery
  • Attending sites at key stages of the project
  • Managing commercial requirements including contracts, variations, retentions, progress claims and final claims
  • Monitoring project performance, costs and margin
  • Identifying issues early and driving practical solutions
  • Ensuring commercial processes and disciplines are consistently followed
This isn't a role where you'll win the work and hand it over.

You'll stay close to your projects, understand what's happening commercially and operationally, and take responsibility for getting them through to a successful outcome.
 
You'll need to be comfortable operating at two levels.

At a broader level, you'll understand the commercial pipeline, maintain important client relationships and ensure the function is operating with the right commercial disciplines.

At project level, you'll be comfortable getting into the detail - reviewing documentation, attending site, coordinating different parties, identifying discrepancies and keeping projects moving.

You'll ideally bring:
  • Strong commercial construction experience
  • Proven project management capability
  • A sound understanding of commercial contracts and project administration
  • Confidence dealing with head contractors, Project Managers and QS's
  • Experience managing multiple projects and competing priorities
  • Commercial awareness across revenue, project costs and margin
  • Experience reviewing construction drawings and project documentation
  • Strong customer and account management capability
  • Confidence following up tenders and commercial opportunities
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong coordination and communication skills
  • A proactive, practical approach to problem-solving
  • Good general digital literacy
Experience within a specialist contractor, subcontractor or construction-related supply environment could translate particularly well, but we're open-minded about the exact sector you've come from.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership.
 
You'll be joining a down-to-earth business with a relatively flat structure, so this isn't an environment where every decision is pushed up through layers of management.

You'll need to be self-directed, comfortable making things happen and willing to get into the detail when required.

We're particularly interested in people who are practical and low ego. You communicate clearly, take accountability when something goes wrong and focus on solving the problem rather than finding someone to blame.
And importantly, you're detail focused.

Success isn't about becoming the best firefighter in the business. It's about spotting the commercial, contractual or project detail early enough that many of those fires don't happen in the first place.
 
What's on offer.
  • $90,000–$120,000 base salary, depending on experience
  • Company vehicle
  • Eligibility for a quarterly company performance bonus linked to overall business performance
  • A Waikato-based role with an established business
  • Genuine ownership and influence across the commercial function
  • Hands-on involvement in projects from tender through to completion
  • An existing commercial workload and relationships to build from
  • The opportunity to help strengthen and develop the commercial function over time
This could suit a Project Manager ready to take on broader commercial ownership, or someone already operating at that level who wants to remain close to project delivery rather than moving into a purely people-management role.

If you understand commercial construction, enjoy the detail of delivering projects and are ready to take ownership beyond your individual jobs, we'd like to hear from you.
